notes.content:

notes.title: AlphaFurry 2 and More!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey everyone![/b][/h2]

We have some amazing news for you.[b] AlphaFurry 2[/b] is officially in the planning phase! 🚀 This time, we're taking things to a whole new level, no longer just an erotic puzzle game, but a full-fledged experience with a deep story, an interactive map, and much more immersive and intimate scenes. We can’t wait to share more details as development progresses!

Meanwhile, we just released [b]Wet and Wild on Steam[/b], and we’re actively monitoring it to catch any remaining bugs. If you haven’t checked it out yet, now’s the perfect time!

But that’s not all, we're also working on a brand-new erotic game featuring intense encounters with [b]monsters and creatures[/b]… yes, even [b]werewolves[/b]! 🐺🔥 This game is set to launch in early April, and we’re sure you’re going to [b]love it.[/b]

With all this in the works, AlphaFurry 2 is expected to be ready by June. We appreciate your patience and support --- it means the world to us! 💖

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for being part of our community!

 The Red Sasori Team

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
🎉 New Update Available! 🎉

We’re excited to announce that a new update for AlphaFurry is now live! This update brings several improvements and fixes to enhance your gaming experience. Here’s what’s new:

✨ [b]Complete image showing in the background prolonged[/b] – Enjoy a more time to finish the level with help of background image.
🎖️ Achievements pop-up fixed – Achievements now show up instantly when earned, so you’ll never miss a moment of glory.
🐛 Various glitches and bugs fixed – We’ve squashed some pesky bugs to make your gameplay smoother than ever.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We hope you enjoy the update, and as always, feel free to share your thoughts with us!
